name: office
description: Essential office suite (LibreOffice), PDF reader (Evince), dictionaries and calendar
_comment: Note: LibreOffice, Evince PDF, aspell & myspell dictionaries, and GNOME Calendar are default. Extra productivity & office tools (CherryTree, Obsidian, Pandoc, GnuCash, Homebank, Recoll, AbiWord, Gnumeric, Scribus, Okular) are listed under 'optional_packages' for easy user enablement.
